name: Supabase Database
description: Postgres database via Supabase with real-time subscriptions, auto-generated REST/GraphQL APIs, and row-level security.

requiredSecrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
requiredSecrets.reason: Service role key for server-side admin operations

postInstallNotes:
1. Use `supabase` (anon key) for client-facing queries subject to row-level security.
2. Use `supabaseAdmin` (service role) for server-side operations that bypass RLS.
3. Define your tables in the Supabase dashboard or via SQL migrations.
4. Enable real-time on tables in the Supabase dashboard, then subscribe with `supabase.channel(...)`.
